description: Post-lowering AST conformance for the 2-D Laplacian on cartesian_uniform_2d assembled from rules central_D2x_neumann_bc + central_D2y_neumann_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=4 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the Laplacian D(D(u,x),x)+D(D(u,y),y) replaced by the sum of the two per-axis makearrays (each with its interior stencil aggregate over the axis and its two ghost-eliminated Neumann faces carrying the free names qXL/qXR/qYL/qYR and dx/dy), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
